Odin × Godot

Box3D upstream reproduction baseline

5 min readOdin × GodotPage source ↓
On this page ↓
Exact revisionsExecuted environment and build settingsReproduction commandsResultsEvidence and limitsStandalone native smoke source

Recorded 2026-10-30 on macOS arm64 for P0.1, board b_cdde1cdfea104035. This report records executed checks, separately from upstream feature claims. It supplies evidence for both the Kit and Replay integration designs; neither framework adapter is implemented by these upstream builds.

Exact revisions#

Component Standalone rollback baseline multi-box-3d game baseline
Top-level repository pdaddyo/rollback-in-a-box at 9e1fe882a0ea4eb52e160d5754a752580b4db462 pdaddyo/multi-box-3d at 987f4ca44d0065676f17cab35edad57fcbb63b13
rollback-in-a-box Same as top level Git submodule 91e01dc75e8dfe3fbd890f21361e27b31fa2e994
Box3D d421e45c828f6f853a145f726f0b9425d31146eb 540ea387b0c02bf714fbfdcc8fb88c039c35fe6f
godot-cpp e83fd0904c13356ed1d4c3d09f8bb9132bdc6b77 (godot-4.5-stable) Same

These are different physics/snapshot baselines. The game's tests exercise its older pinned shim and cannot establish correctness of the current standalone engine-neutral extraction. Its submodule was not advanced for this audit.

Sources: standalone dependency setup, game dependency setup, game submodule.

Executed environment and build settings#

  • macOS 15.8, build 24H23, arm64.
  • Apple Clang 16.0.0 (clang-1600.0.26.6), Xcode SDK 15.2.
  • CMake 3.31.3, GNU Make 3.81, Python 3.9.6.
  • Godot /Applications/Godot.app/Contents/MacOS/Godot, verified 4.7.1.stable.official.a13da4feb.
  • Debug GDExtension builds, GODOTCPP_TARGET=template_debug, arm64, C++17 and position-independent code. Generated compile commands show -ffp-contract=off in Box3D, the shim, the neutral core, and game simulation; no fast-math flag was enabled. Debug compilation used -g.
  • Used Unix Makefiles instead of documented Ninja because Ninja was absent from both the host PATH and this repository's Nix development shell. This changes the build executor; source pins and simulation compiler flags were kept. Standalone compilation used eight jobs, game compilation six.
  • The Nix development shell successfully resolved Odin dev-2026-04 and the same installed Godot; it was not needed to compile these C/C++ projects.

Reproduction commands#

Run each project in a separate scratch checkout. Restore its listed revision before dependency setup; the game setup initializes its exact Git submodule.

Shell
git clone https://github.com/pdaddyo/rollback-in-a-box.git rollback-in-a-box
git -C rollback-in-a-box checkout --detach 9e1fe882a0ea4eb52e160d5754a752580b4db462
cd rollback-in-a-box
./gdext/setup_deps.sh
cmake -S gdext -B gdext/build-debug -G 'Unix Makefiles' \
  -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug -DGODOTCPP_TARGET=template_debug \
  -DCMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS=ON
cmake --build gdext/build-debug --parallel 8
python3 tools/generate_bindings.py --check
GODOT=/Applications/Godot.app/Contents/MacOS/Godot ./tests/run_all.sh
Shell
git clone https://github.com/pdaddyo/multi-box-3d.git multi-box-3d
git -C multi-box-3d checkout --detach 987f4ca44d0065676f17cab35edad57fcbb63b13
cd multi-box-3d
./gdext/setup_deps.sh
cmake -S gdext -B gdext/build-debug -G 'Unix Makefiles' \
  -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug -DGODOTCPP_TARGET=template_debug \
  -DCMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS=ON
cmake --build gdext/build-debug --parallel 6
GODOT=/Applications/Godot.app/Contents/MacOS/Godot ./tests/run_all.sh

Results#

The standalone Debug GDExtension built successfully. All 14 standalone headless suites passed in 10.88 seconds, including raw API creation of six shape families and nine joint families, restore/resimulation diagnostics, two/three/four-player impairment cases, scope telemetry, recording/playback, and negative edge cases. The game's exact-pinned Debug GDExtension also built successfully. Its full headless runner passed all ten suites plus the two-process real-UDP test in 44.12 seconds. Scene/demo wiring, 600-frame diagnostic determinism and 16 rewinds, vehicle dynamics and 24 rewinds, all 52 part types across 13 samples, droids, creatures, recording/playback and impaired loopback completed.

Executed check Observed result
Current standalone Debug GDExtension Build passes
Current standalone generated binding coverage Pass; 695 functions
Current standalone headless runner 14/14 suites pass, exit 0
Current neutral core without Godot 101-body restore/resimulation smoke passes
Game at exact submodule/Box3D pins Debug build passes
Game headless runner 10/10 suites plus two-process UDP pass, exit 0

The recorded runner durations include process startup and tests on this host; they are not the later snapshot/save/restore/replay performance benchmark.

Negative marshaling and replay-lifecycle tests deliberately emit native ERROR: guard diagnostics and corrupt-file messages. Their case checks and suite exit statuses passed. The log contains no SCRIPT ERROR:, Parse Error: or FAIL:. This distinction matters when inspecting the raw log: native guard diagnostics are not a failed positive-path test.

The real-UDP case uses localhost ports 7801/7802 and reached matching frame-1200 diagnostic hashes. It is a clean-delivery test, with zero rollback frames; loss/jitter and actual rollback are exercised by the separate in-process loopback cases. No SCRIPT ERROR:, Parse Error:, FAIL:, WARNING: or native ERROR: appeared in the game runner log. Its Steam autoload initialized the installed client, but live-account Steam gameplay was not tested. Account identifiers from local logs are intentionally omitted here.

The standalone generated binding check passed:

Text
Box3D API: 695 functions, 108 structs, 215 enum constants

A separate scratch C++ executable linked only the current core static library and its pinned Box3D library. otool -L lists only libc++ and libSystem, with no Godot dynamic dependency. It created 100 dynamic boxes and a static floor, recorded 240 frames, restored frame 60 and matched all 180 subsequent diagnostic hashes, then added a sphere, restored frame zero, verified the sphere and its body-table entry disappeared, and matched all 240 subsequent diagnostic hashes. It also checked restored frame counters and live-body counts.

Text
PASS neutral core: 101 bodies, 240-tick baseline, 180+240 replayed hashes, spawned-body rollback; final=f82df34ea1c56292

This is observed motion-hash agreement and lifecycle/count agreement, not proof that every hidden solver field matches. The upstream world hash covers live transforms and awake velocities, combined with wrapper side-state; contacts, joint internals, ID pools and sleep timers are not a complete part of that hash. A full solver-state digest and corresponding mutation tests remain a Gate A acceptance requirement. See the snapshot audit.

Evidence and limits#

Scratch checkouts, generated compile commands, logs, and the standalone harness are under:

Text
/var/folders/f5/n795h3hd5nxbqwzvt3t6bpcw0000gp/T/box3d-phase0-qu5lt6zn/baseline/

The report retains the important observations and exact revisions; scratch paths are local working evidence and may be removed by system temporary-file cleanup. The standalone harness source and executable are neutral-core-smoke.cpp and neutral-core-smoke; its successful output is neutral-core-smoke.log.

No tracked upstream files were modified. Godot import generated an untracked docs/logo.png.import sidecar in the standalone scratch clone.

Recorded runner log SHA-256 values:

Log SHA-256
rollback-in-a-box-tests.log 8a4a48a2715a88a93cd6950fee3c15b8bce7bc553cdd4a24f2895f5b0a160a8b
multi-box-3d-tests.log 05d288c30eb24afecbed661c64de34543d660c809ee74d78bbde85f12c8de037

These checks do not establish Kit integration, Replay integration, canonical cross-build recovery, cross-platform determinism, release-build behavior, performance budgets, or interactive rendering quality. Those remain separate roadmap acceptance gates. Upstream peer-session tests also do not select or replace either sibling framework's authority/network model.

Standalone native smoke source#

For reproduction, save this as neutral-core-smoke.cpp beside the standalone checkout, then compile from the checkout after its Debug core target is built:

Shell
/usr/bin/clang++ -std=c++17 -ffp-contract=off \
  -Icore/include -Icore/include/box3d_rollback -Igdext/extern/box3d/include \
  ../neutral-core-smoke.cpp \
  gdext/build-debug/core/libbox3d_rollback_neutral.a \
  gdext/build-debug/extern/box3d/src/libbox3dd.a -o ../neutral-core-smoke
../neutral-core-smoke

Assertions must remain enabled. This harness does not constitute the later full solver-state digest or random-rewind performance benchmark.

cpp
#include "box3d_rollback/rb_world.h"
#include <array>
#include <cassert>
#include <cstdio>

int main() {
    const int64_t neutral_inputs[2] = {0,0};
    rb::RollbackWorld world;
    world.create_world();
    world.add_static_box({0,-1,0}, {30,1,30});
    for (int i=0;i<100;++i) {
        world.add_dynamic_box({float(i%10)*1.1f-5.0f,2.0f+float(i/10)*1.1f,0}, {0.5f,0.5f,0.5f});
    }
    world.init_snapshots(2);
    std::array<uint64_t,241> hashes{};
    hashes[0]=world.get_state_hash();
    assert(world.save_state(0));
    for (int tick=1;tick<=240;++tick) {
        world.step_frame(neutral_inputs,2);
        hashes[tick]=world.get_state_hash();
        if(tick==60) assert(world.save_state(1));
    }
    assert(world.load_state(1));
    assert(world.get_frame()==60 && world.get_live_body_count()==101);
    assert(world.get_state_hash()==hashes[60]);
    for(int tick=61;tick<=240;++tick) {
        world.step_frame(neutral_inputs,2);
        assert(world.get_state_hash()==hashes[tick]);
    }
    world.add_dynamic_sphere({0,20,0},0.5f);
    assert(world.get_live_body_count()==102);
    assert(world.load_state(0));
    assert(world.get_frame()==0 && world.get_live_body_count()==101);
    assert(world.get_state_hash()==hashes[0]);
    for(int tick=1;tick<=240;++tick) {
        world.step_frame(neutral_inputs,2);
        assert(world.get_state_hash()==hashes[tick]);
    }
    std::printf("PASS neutral core: 101 bodies, 240-tick baseline, 180+240 replayed hashes, spawned-body rollback; final=%016llx\n", static_cast<unsigned long long>(hashes[240]));
}
